findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: The kitchen’s sanitizer bucket was tested at 0ppm (quat). The sani solution was recreated and tested at 200ppm (quat) to correct the violation. Ensure that all sanitizer solutions are testing at the manufacturer's recommended concentration to effectively sanitize food contact surfaces.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(C) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (C) A quaternary ammonium compound solution shall: (1) Have a minimum temperature of 24°C (75°F), (2) Have a concentration as specified under § 7-204.11 and as indicated by the manufacturer's use directions included in the labeling, and (3) Be used only in water with 500 MG/L hardness or less or in water having a hardness no greater than specified by the EPA-registered label use instructions.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used.
findings.comment: The gasket along the outdoor freezer is starting to tear. The PIC mentioned that new gaskets have been ordered to replace the current ones. Temperatures were observed compliant, however, be aware that the gasket will container to tear overtime. Ensure that gasket is replaced.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.11(A) Good Repair and Proper Adjustment. (A) EQUIPMENT shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: The women’s hand-sink is in need of recaulking. The current caulk is peeling away from the wall. Discussed with the owner and he mentioned that the facility will have the sink recaulked soon. Ensure that physical facilities are maintained in good repair to prevent accumulated debris.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Food separated and protected.
findings.comment: REPEAT- There were raw beef patties observed to be over milk, raw shelled eggs, jalapeños, and a container of dressing. This was discussed with the PIC and a handout on storage order was provided. CORRECTED- The raw beef patties were moved to be below these items. Ensure that food is protected from contamination during storage, preparation, holding, and display.
findings.citation_text: 3-302.11(A)(1) Packaged and Unpackaged Food - Separation, Packaging, and Segregation. (A) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by: (1) Except as specified in (1)(d) below or when combined as ingredients, separating raw animal FOODS during storage, preparation, holding, and display from: (a) Raw READY-TO-EAT FOOD including other raw animal FOOD such as FISH for sushi or MOLLUSCAN SHELLFISH, or other raw READY-TOEAT FOOD such as fruits and vegetables, (b) Cooked READY-TO-EAT FOOD, and (c) Fruits and vegetables before they are washed; (d) Frozen, commercially processed and packaged raw animal FOOD may be stored or displayed with or above frozen, commercially processed and packaged, ready-to-eat food.

findings.title: Approved thawing methods used.
findings.comment: There were reduced oxygen packages of salmon that were observed to be thawed and in the cooler. These packages of salmon state to remove from packaging prior to thawing and had not been removed from the packaging. This was discussed with the PIC who was informed that this fish either needs to be removed entirely from the packaging or a cut needs to be placed in the packaging prior to being thawed. CORRECTED- A cut was placed in each packaging of fish to correct the violation. Ensure that all reduced oxygen packaged fish is removed from the reduced oxygen environment prior to thawing.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.13(E) Thawing. Except as specified in (D) of this section, TIME/TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY FOOD shall be thawed: (E) REDUCED OXYGEN PACKAGED FISH that bears a label indicating that it is to be kept frozen until time of use shall be removed from the reduced oxygen environment: (1) Prior to its thawing under refrigeration as specified in (A) of this section; or (2) Prior to, or Immediately upon completion of, its thawing using procedures specified in (B) of this section.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used.
findings.comment:
The following equipment is observed to be in need of repair: 

1. The handwashing sink in the kitchen, the triple sink in the kitchen, and the table next to the dish machine are all observed to need to be caulked to the wall. 
2. There are cracked gaskets on a cooler and a freezer in the kitchen. This was discussed with the PIC who stated that they have ordered more gaskets and will be replacing them soon. 

Ensure that equipment is maintained in good repair.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.11(A) Good Repair and Proper Adjustment. (A) EQUIPMENT shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
REPEAT- The floors, walls, ceiling, and vent covers throughout the facility are in need of a deep cleaning. The walls, ceilings, and vent covers above the steam table, pizza oven, and the dish area were observed to have dust accumulation. The walls in the kitchen have built-up food splatter on them. Ensure that these physical facilities are cleaned and maintained cleaned. 

The coolers/freezers and gaskets of them are in need of cleaning in the kitchen. This was discussed with the PIC as well. Ensure that these are cleaned.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.12 Cleaning, Frequency and Restrictions. (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Food separated and protected.
findings.comment: Several containers of shelled eggs were stored on the top shelf of a cooler along the cook-line. The shelled eggs were stored above Ready-to-eat food items such as but not limited to cooked rice. Discussed with PIC and eggs were placed on the bottom shelf to correct the violation. Be sure to always store raw animal protein below RTE foods to protect against contamination.
findings.citation_text: 3-302.11(A)(1) Packaged and Unpackaged Food - Separation, Packaging, and Segregation. (A) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by: (1) Except as specified in (1)(d) below or when combined as ingredients, separating raw animal FOODS during storage, preparation, holding, and display from: (a) Raw READY-TO-EAT FOOD including other raw animal FOOD such as FISH for sushi or MOLLUSCAN SHELLFISH, or other raw READY-TOEAT FOOD such as fruits and vegetables, (b) Cooked READY-TO-EAT FOOD, and (c) Fruits and vegetables before they are washed; (d) Frozen, commercially processed and packaged raw animal FOOD may be stored or displayed with or above frozen, commercially processed and packaged, ready-to-eat food.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
Floors, walls, ceilings, and vent covers throughout the facility are in need of a deep cleaning. Vent covers and the ceiling above the steam table, pizza oven, as well as in the dish area, were observed with a significant amount of dust accumulation. The walls in the kitchen area were also observed with food splatter. When closing for the night or during slow periods, be sure to give the above described areas a deep cleaning and maintain as frequent as necessary.  

** The floor underneath shelves in the outdoor walk in freezer are in need of cleaning. Clean as frequent as necessary to prevent debris buildup.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Food separated and protected
findings.comment:
Observed a container of burger patties to be stored above shrimp in a cooler. Discussed with PIC and containers were rearranged. Ensure that seafood is always stored above raw meats in order to prevent cross contamination. 

3-302.11: (A) (1)-(2) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination during storage, preparation, holding, and display (P). (3) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by cleaning visibly soiled containers, removing damaged containers, separating washed and unwashed produce (C).

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Observed the ceilings and walls in the kitchen area to be soiled with debris. Ensure that ceilings and walls are cleaned as frequent as necessary to prevent accumulated debris. 

6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.
